result:
I built the PERF-1a perf harness (`npm run test:perf`). It passed twice on the final code, and `app/` is untouched. C still has to verify every acceptance row. The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-206.md`.

**Files changed (only the granted and new paths):**
- New: `playwright.perf.config.ts`, `perf/studio-lab.perf.spec.ts`, `perf/lib/{instrumentation,stats,budgets}.ts`, `perf/budgets.json` (161 rows), and doc 163 in Georgian. Its status line reads "C round 206 check pending" for root to amend.
- `package.json`: the one `test:perf` line.
- Doc 162: line 4 only.
- All 1,039 frozen files still match their hashes. Protected files and root's :5173 server were not touched.

**Checks I ran on the final tree:**
- `npm run typecheck` exits 0.
- `npm run lint` exits 0 with no errors (lint only covers `./app`).
- `npm run test:perf`, two separate runs: both exit 0 with no failures, in 383 s and 422 s (under the 12 min target). All 59 deterministic medians are identical between the two runs.
- My red-proof (a budgets copy where `harness.restart-live` needs ≥ 1000 and `fader.track.stopped.components-per-commit` is set to assert ≤ 3): exits 1 and names both rows with their measured values, 1 and 83.
- Neither the default nor the smoke config lists any perf spec.
- The literal `npx biome format perf …` checks nothing: `biome.json` only includes `app/**`. I checked a copy of the files with the project's Biome settings instead; it is clean.

**Measured medians (re-rendered components per commit):**

| Fader | B's probe | Mine (stopped / playing) |
|---|---|---|
| Track volume | 83 | 83 / 83 |
| Master | 80 | 80 / 80 |
| Pan | 4 | 4 / 4 |
| Group (new, no reference) | — | 85 / 85 |
| Clip gain (new, no reference) | — | 79 / 87 |

- Nothing differs from B's numbers by more than 15 %, and the counts are the same at 1× and 6× CPU.
- No fader drag restarts the audio graph while playing (0 everywhere), and moves dispatched are 121 everywhere.
- Clip gain is the worst case: it is the only fader that drops frames at 1× while playing (p95 33.4 ms; 66.6 ms at 6×).

**Code review:** I ran the code-reviewer twice and fixed all its High and Medium findings. They included:
- results not being written if a step failed;
- no proof that the fader actually moved during the drag;
- fixed wait times after release;
- observer errors that were never reported;
- `start()` calls not grouped per task;
- two report bugs that only show up when a run is partial or aborted.

The fixes for the second review were not reviewed again; root's reviewer will see that code. Architecture note for B (from review 1): keep the structure; if PERF-1b adds its scenarios to the same spec, move aggregation and report writing into `perf/lib/report.ts`.

**Decisions and remaining notes:**
- **Pass order:** I read "group last" as creating the group only after the other four faders were measured both stopped and playing. That keeps the other eight scenarios group-free, the same as B's probe. The exact sequence is saved in every result file so C can replay it.
- **Harness bug found and fixed:** at 6× the playhead runs past the visible area and the timeline scrolls. My grab point then landed on the lane headers, so the clip drag did nothing. It happens at 1× too after the same scroll, so it is not an app bug. The grab point is now picked by hit-testing the clip.
- **`remix-serve` listens on all interfaces (`*:5188`), not only 127.0.0.1:** binding it locally would need a B ruling.
- **Not run by me (gate rows):** the full test suite, `npm run verify`, the smoke e2e, and the auth guard checks.

The report also lists the exact budget-file edits for C's red-proofs and the next C checks.
